description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of tokens and sentences across various domains in the SALT dataset. The horizontal axis represents different categories, including Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, News, Science, and Blogs. The vertical axis indicates the number of sentences, measured in thousands (K). The chart shows that the News category has the highest number of sentences, with 902K, followed by Administrative with 525K. Religion has 50K sentences, Non-fiction has 190K, Fiction has 35K, Law has 23K, Science has 110K, and Blogs have the least with 2K sentences. Each bar is colored in red, and the values are annotated above the bars in blue text. The chart does not include any additional visual emphasis such as shading or bolding, and the bars are not sorted in any specific order.
